mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above a 5% month-over-month growth rate signals strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST MoM > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points in a single meeting signals a hawkish monetary policy stance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases > 25bps.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer demand and labor market tightness, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and tight labor market
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals strong job growth, which is a positive indicator for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO decreases and CPIAUCSL increases.
